messages:
Nora (CS): Heads-up: RadiantQ renewal discussion. They want to shorten term to 9 months, request a 10% pro-rated discount, and procurement says PO + vendor code required before finance will release payment. Onboarding is blocked until we get either PO or prepay. Ideas?
Evan (AE): On call now with Ben from Radiant AP — they can issue PO but need invoice billed to 'RadiantQ EU' and vendor code 'RADIANTQ-EU'. They also asked if we can sign now and allow them 14 days to return PO.
Lina (Finance): We require PO on file before switching billing terms. We can accept PO post-sign but access is gated until PO or payment is received. Net-45 is our standard for renewals; Net-60 requires a credit check.
Ben (Radiant AP): Confirmed: procurement wants SOW signed ASAP to start services. PO issuance depends on legal entity mapping and vendor code insertion. They can expedite if invoice stub matches their template.
Marco (Legal): There's a mismatch on signature party: Radiant wants the SOW signed by 'Redwood Inference Ltd' but our corporate name on current SOW is 'Redwood Inc.' I can prepare a redline to update party name and add a short clause allowing 14-day PO submission after signing (conditional access withheld until PO). Also customer asked about key export policy — we don't allow customer-controlled keys on hosted; Private addendum required.
Nora (CS): Okay — @Evan confirm they accept staged hosted start with access only after PO or prepay. Evan?
Evan (AE): They prefer signed SOW before internal procurement queueing. They can pull PO in 2 business days if SOW party and invoice lines match. I'll push for their credit team to expedite.
Ivy (Onboarding): If we get signed SOW + PO, I can schedule kickoff within 48 hours. If SOW signed but PO delayed, we can hold a non-prod enablement session (no production access) so they don't fall behind. Need final user list and SSO domain to prepare.
Lina (Finance): I'll provide a one-page invoice stub for AP to attach. Also note: if they're asking for 10% discount on 9-month term, finance needs AE approval; we need clear reasoning for concession.
Evan (AE): Their reason: mid-year procurement freeze, will commit to 12 months at renewal if we accept 9-month with discount now. I'll try to negotiate 5% instead of 10% and request documented commitment for 12-month renewal.
Marco (Legal): I'll draft the redline (party name + 14-day PO clause) and prepare DocuSign envelope. If they require key custody now, escalate and we'll propose Private timeline.
DocuSign Bot: DocuSign envelope prepared: https://docusign.com/envelope/1a2b3c (status: sent).
Ben (Radiant AP): I'll review the stub. Can you include vendor code field and our PO-number placeholder? That helps routing.
Lina (Finance): Stub to send to Radiant AP:

``
Bill To: RadiantQ EU
Vendor Code: RADIANTQ-EU
PO #: __________________
Invoice #: RW-2026-711
Term: 9 months (pro-rated)
Amount: $27,000 (requested 10% off)
Remit: acctspayable@redwood.ai
Tax ID: 12-3456789
Note: PO required for production access
``

Nora (CS): Action items: Evan push for PO + accept 5% counteroffer, Marco send redline/DocuSign, Lina share stub with AP, Ivy prepare onboarding non-prod checklist if SOW signed pre-PO. Follow up EOD. :calendar:
